req.title: Player deletion persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall remove the row from the players table so GET returns 404 afterwards.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that DELETE /players/{playerId} (implemented as DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}) must remove the row from the players table so a subsequent GET returns 404. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — delete an existing player and verify 204 then 404 on re-fetch; (2) STC — full state transition: exists → deleted → not-found; (3) NEG — delete a non-existent player returns 404; (4) BVA — delete the lowest squad number (1) and highest (26) to catch off-by-one mutations; (5) DT — delete already-deleted player returns 404 (idempotency / double-delete). All assertions use exact status codes and exact response bodies to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=10 exists in the database (pre-loaded fixture row)
expected: DELETE returns HTTP 204 with no body
Subsequent GET returns HTTP 404 confirming row is removed from DB
trace: R-PLAYER-021: system shall remove the row so GET returns 404 afterwards
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404():
    del_resp = client.delete("/players/squadnumber/10")
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    assert del_resp.content == b""
    get_resp = client.get("/players/squadnumber/10")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 404

test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404()

tests.name: test_state_transition_exists_to_deleted_to_not_found
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=15 exists in the database (pre-loaded fixture row)
actions: Send DELETE /players/squadnumber/15 — transition to deleted state (204)
Send DELETE /players/squadnumber/15 again — confirm double-delete returns 404
expected: Initial GET returns 200 with correct squad number
Second DELETE returns 404 (player no longer exists)
trace: R-PLAYER-021: full state transition — present → deleted → absent; double-delete idempotency
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_state_transition_exists_to_deleted_to_not_found():
    get1 = client.get("/players/squadnumber/15")
    assert get1.status_code == 200
    body = get1.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 15
    del1 = client.delete("/players/squadnumber/15")
    assert del1.status_code == 204
    assert del1.content == b""
    get2 = client.get("/players/squadnumber/15")
    assert get2.status_code == 404
    del2 = client.delete("/players/squadnumber/15")
    assert del2.status_code == 404

test_state_transition_exists_to_deleted_to_not_found()

tests.name: test_delete_player_by_uuid_get_returns_404
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=5 exists in the database with known UUID 2b515093-76be-4c72-98de-729c368f7ddb
actions: Send GET /players/2b515093-76be-4c72-98de-729c368f7ddb to confirm player exists
Send DELETE /players/squadnumber/5 to remove the player
Send GET /players/2b515093-76be-4c72-98de-729c368f7ddb to confirm UUID-based lookup also returns 404
expected: UUID GET after deletion returns 404 — row is gone from DB
trace: R-PLAYER-021: deletion persists to DB — both natural-key and surrogate-key lookups must return 404 after delete
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_delete_player_by_uuid_get_returns_404():
    player_uuid = "2b515093-76be-4c72-98de-729c368f7ddb"
    get1 = client.get(f"/players/{player_uuid}")
    assert get1.status_code == 200
    assert get1.json()["squadNumber"] == 5
    del_resp = client.delete("/players/squadnumber/5")
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    assert del_resp.content == b""
    get2 = client.get(f"/players/{player_uuid}")
    assert get2.status_code == 404

test_delete_player_by_uuid_get_returns_404()
